title: Freeze record I/O: load, save, validate
description: Owns rcf/define/freeze.json. FREEZE_RECORD_REL_PATH, FreezeRecordError (coded parseFailure | schemaFailure | ioFailure with a named field), validateFreezeRecord, loadFreezeRecord (returns null on ENOENT), saveFreezeRecord (validates first; refuses to persist an invalid record; creates rcf/define/ on demand; writes pretty JSON with a trailing newline). The record's local schema is documented at the top of this file and covered by test/define/freeze-record.test.js.
